general: You wonder if there's any way to get promoted to leader in the Dark Forest.
You reminisce about when your hunting patrols would return with heaps of prey in their jaws.
You almost had it all, and then it was taken from you.
You make the best of your situation and try to act as deputy in the Dark Forest, hoping the familiarity would do you some good.
You and l_n are getting into arguments more often than not, these moons.
You watch, hopelessly, as the seasons change and c_n along with it.
